display.title: Tisha B'Av: Ahavas Yisroel and the Ancient Tune of Eicha
display.summary_short: On the eve of Tisha B'Av, Uncle Yossi explains that love for every Jew will rebuild the Beis HaMikdash, and introduces the ancient tune of Eicha with the verse Hashiveinu.
display.summary_long: A Tisha B'Av talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, recorded two days before the fast. Uncle Yossi explains that Tisha B'Av is the saddest day in Jewish history, when the Beis HaMikdash was destroyed, and that we fast and pray for the exile to end and for the day to become a Yom Tov. The Beis HaMikdash was destroyed because of baseless hatred, so it will be rebuilt through Ahavas Yisroel. He then speaks about the power of music: the Levi'im sang in the Beis HaMikdash, and when Moshiach comes we will sing a new song as Moshe and the Jewish people did leaving Egypt. Even though there is no music during the Three Weeks, there is one tune we sing even on Tisha B'Av, the tune of Eicha read in shul. The clip plays the verse Hashiveinu, explains its meaning, and has the children repeat it.
display.lesson: The Beis HaMikdash was destroyed through baseless hatred; love for every Jew and heartfelt prayer will bring it back.
